species.name: White bass
why: Water 47°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–16 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
Northwest wind at 20 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
